title: Quest. 128. Is the Lords day a Sabbath, and so to be called and kept, and that of Divine institution? And is the seventh day Sabbath abrogated, &c.

segments.text: Answ. ALL the Cases about the Lords day (except those practical directions for keeping it, in the Oeconomical part of this Book) I have put into a peculiar Treatise on that subject by it self; and therefore shall here pass them over, referring the Reader to them in that discourse.
